patterns.note: Full-width dark background with centered, content-constrained sections that use generous vertical spacing to delineate information blocks.
Prominent use of very large, bold sans-serif numbers for statistics, contrasted with elegant serif headings and smaller, legible sans-serif body text.
A consistent dark mode palette featuring a deep charcoal background, off-white text, and subtle, muted accent colors (pink, purple, blue, green) for data visualization elements.
A continuous, subtle background animation of connecting dots and lines, creating a network effect, is present in the hero section and appears to persist throughout the page's background.
Data-driven sections are introduced with a concise heading, followed by large statistics and supporting details, often visualized with minimalist horizontal bar charts.

technique_notes: A persistent dark background is used across the entire page, providing a high-contrast canvas for light-colored text and data visualizations.
Large, impactful numerical statistics are used as primary visual anchors, drawing immediate attention to key data points and conveying authority.
A subtle, continuously animating background of connecting nodes and lines (implemented with canvas) adds a dynamic yet unobtrusive layer of visual interest, particularly in the hero section.

design_tokens.type_scale: oversized serif hero title (~4x body) with very large, bold sans-serif numbers (~5x body) and small, legible sans-serif body text.
design_tokens.radius: subtle, with slightly rounded corners on buttons and chart elements.
design_tokens.spacing: airy, especially in the hero section and between major content blocks, creating a sense of spaciousness and focus on individual data points.

standout: This site's design stands out by transforming a data-heavy report into an engaging, high-contrast experience. The combination of a deep dark background, elegant serif headings, and extremely large, bold numerical statistics, complemented by a subtle animated network background, creates a sophisticated and authoritative feel that elevates the content beyond a typical static report.
